1.name: Sickness

effects.text: When played, discard the next 2 cards from your deck.

1.text: {triggeredForced} When played, discard the next 2 cards from your deck.
1.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: Now discards 2 cards instead of 1 and costs 7 instead of 6 trade goods to upgrade.
There are 2 solutions to this sickness. Either you amputate your leg. It is cheap, but it doesn't really give you the best possible future. Alternatively, you gather all the trade goods you have and use it to get a cure for your sickness. What will it be?

2.name: Crippled
2.helpText: VERSION NOTE: In 1st printing, this stage gives -4 fame.

description:
VERSION NOTE: Crippled gives -2 instead of -4 fame.
Sickness discards 2 cards instead of 1 and the upgrade costs 7 trade goods instead of 6.
The Feast now gives 2 fame instead of 0.
Well, you could amputate it... or pay for better medical care.
